_comment: Safe Room NPCs. 'tile' is the Safe Room map character the NPC stands on (see data/saferoom.json); 'chat' is the CSS colour key for their Chat lines (.chat-<name>); 'lines' are what they say when Carl steps on their tile or presses U. 'image' is the card art, 'portrait' the optional Guide portrait.

npcs.name: Bautista
npcs.description: Runs the Safe Room shop: a knee-high slab of ex-pro-wrestler behind a counter of supplies, with a permanent scowl. Press U on his tile to trade — BUY tab for gear, SELL tab to dump loot. Every price is a haggle: he quotes a number, then a LUCK roll decides what Carl actually pays or pockets (a crit robs him blind, a fumble gets you fleeced).
lines: Shop's open. Press U. BUY tab, SELL tab, and don't argue the quote — that's what the haggle's for.
You want gear or you want to unload junk? Either way it's U, and either way I get my cut.
Every price is a negotiation, pal. Bring your LUCK and press U.

npcs.name: Mistress Tiatha
npcs.description: The Safe Room's Spell Master — an ageless, impatient elf who deals in magic she doesn't think you're ready for. Press U on her tile to buy spells.
lines: The spell trade is open. Stand on my mark, press U, and do not haggle.
One spell on the shelf and it is already more than you can handle. Press U to look.
Gold for words, Crawler. Press U on my tile when you are ready to spend.

npcs.name: Hekla
npcs.description: The Safe Room's Guild Master: a scarred mountain of a warrior who turns stat points into muscle. Stand on her tile and press U to train — spend your banked points to raise STR, DEX, CON or LUCK by 1 apiece. There's no cap and no refund.
lines: Guild's open for business, Crawler. Stand on my mark and press U — I'll turn those banked points into muscle.
You've bled, you've levelled. Bring the points here: press U and we'll put them where they'll do some good.
Training hall's running. Press U on my tile whenever you've got points to spend — no cap on how far you push it.

npcs.name: Princess Donut
npcs.description: Carl's cat and combat partner. A pampered, award-winning Persian with a sharp tongue and sharper claws, she pulls more than her weight in a fight — and keeps up a running commentary from the sidelines, in Chat. (Her spoken lines are scripted in the game code, not here.)

npcs.name: Mordecai
npcs.description: Your System-appointed guide. He handles your listings, feeds you advice through the Guide Book, and is the only friendly voice down here — though "friendly" comes with plenty of dry commentary.
lines: You again. Press U and I'll walk you through whatever you've forgotten.
Guide Book's open whenever you are — press U. Try to retain it this time.
Everything you need to survive is one button away. It's U. It's always U.

npcs.name: Chris the Bopca
npcs.description: The Bopca who keeps the Safe Room's stairs down and its floors clean. Unimpressed by crawlers.
lines: Rest, restock, whatever. Just don't track dungeon in on my floor.
This is a safe room. Keep it that way and we'll get along.
Bunk's there, locker's there, stairs down are there. Don't dawdle.
